subject.title: [Feature]:  Shared sessions across multiple group/channel/thread chats

question: What shared-session contract should OpenClaw support for selected group/channel/thread chats, and should this issue remain the canonical tracker for that broader contract?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally isolate non-DM channel/thread sessions, while the requested config changes transcript and sandbox trust boundaries and overlaps multiple active routing proposals.

options.title: Design one explicit shared-session contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and reconcile channelGroups, groupScope, named inbound routing, and identity routing into one documented opt-in design.

options.title: Stage the narrower groupScope path first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91702 only for the focused group-to-main case while this broader issue continues to track selected channel/thread groups.

options.title: Defer core routing changes
options.body: Document explicit memory/handoff workflows as the supported workaround for now, accepting that they do not provide live transcript sharing.

recommendation.title: Design one explicit shared-session contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and reconcile channelGroups, groupScope, named inbound routing, and identity routing into one documented opt-in design.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest visible history across the routing/config files and prior reviews for this session-routing cluster.
